name: gstack-pilot
description: Portable three-mode operating system for Claude Code (Advisor/Commander/Execute), natively chained into the gstack skill suite - Commander's planning phase chains into gstack's office-hours/plan-eng-review/autoplan, Execute's wrap-up chains into gstack's review/qa/ship on a PR-first flow. Sibling plugin to role-modes, for projects that also run gstack.
